statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Delayed NQ evidence remains two-way and does not verify persistent mean-reversion failure.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The main conditional risk window is 13:30-15:30 UTC around the cash open, Flash PMI, Barr and EIA.
headline: Low Tail, extreme Stress; the open/PMI cluster remains the narrow conditional danger window.
body: Delayed December NQ feeds place futures roughly around 31,000-31,045, below the overnight high near 31,095 and within a broad two-way range. Feed timestamps are not fully consistent, so the assessment does not infer a persistent no-retracement path. VIX is near 14, Treasury yields remain elevated, and oil has softened while Middle East risk persists.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 clock-hours, Tail was mostly low, briefly reaching 27% around the prior U.S. open before falling back below WATCH; Stress stayed high to extreme.
outlookSummary: Base-case Tail stays low outside the 13:30-15:30 UTC open/PMI/Fed/EIA cluster; escalation requires observed persistent direction, shallow pullbacks, failed retracements, or a coherent second leg.

forecast.analysis: If the initial U.S. move develops meaningful retracements, event pressure should fade; continued repeated extension would prolong WATCH conditions.
Mid-afternoon Tail remains at WATCH only if an earlier directional move still resists meaningful retracement; stabilization would keep the path recoverable.
Absent a fresh catalyst, Tail returns low if earlier direction has already produced normal retracement depth and no new extension sequence develops.
drivers: Normal retracement depth versus renewed extension

forecast.analysis: If price remains two-way into late afternoon, low Tail is preserved; renewed one-way efficiency near a session extreme would be the condition for reassessment.
Into the final cash-session hour, low Tail assumes no fresh sequence of failed pullbacks. Power-hour continuation would matter only if retracements remain shallow.
drivers: Absence of repeated extension after failed pullbacks

forecast.analysis: After the cash close, Tail stays low if directional pressure dissipates and no late catalyst creates a fresh one-way repricing sequence.
drivers: Late catalyst risk versus pressure decay

forecast.analysis: Early overnight conditions are expected to be lower intensity unless a new headline disrupts the post-close equilibrium; Tail remains low conditionally.
Low Tail persists conditionally if overnight price discovery remains balanced and cross-assets do not align into a fresh directional impulse.
The overnight base case remains normal if meaningful counter-moves continue to appear; a persistent break with shallow pullbacks would invalidate that condition.
Conditional Tail remains low in thinner overnight trade unless directional efficiency increases and repeated extensions begin to dominate normal retracement behavior.
As Asian participation develops, Tail edges higher only if a regional move aligns with NQ and resists meaningful retracement; otherwise two-way structure dominates.
drivers: NQ retracement depth after regional impulses

forecast.analysis: A mixed overnight regime remains the base case. Tail would require a sustained directional leg reinforced by regional technology and cross-asset confirmation.
drivers: Cross-asset confirmation of any directional leg

forecast.analysis: Conditional risk remains low unless the overnight range breaks with weak counter-moves and the move persists into the Europe handoff.
Near the Europe handoff, Tail approaches the top of low only if an overnight direction remains efficient; range re-entry would keep the structure recoverable.
drivers: Overnight range re-entry versus persistent direction

forecast.analysis: European participation could amplify an overnight move, but low Tail assumes meaningful pullbacks remain available and no cross-asset stack becomes fully aligned.
Conditional Tail stays low if Europe produces two-way price discovery; shallow retracements alongside aligned technology strength or weakness would be the escalation signal.
